options.B: The safety surcharge levied on passenger fares and grants received from the Central Road Fund
options.C: Appropriations made from the Depreciation Reserve Fund
options.D: Licence fees recovered for the use of railway land

q: A sanction accorded to expenditure on a work does not, by itself, authorise the incurring of that expenditure unless:

options.A: Funds for the purpose have been allotted in the budget
options.B: The work has been completed and taken over
options.C: The tender for the work has been accepted
options.D: The completion report has been vetted by Finance

q: Under the General Financial Rules, a rush of expenditure in the closing months of the financial year, particularly in March, is treated as:

options.A: Evidence of efficient utilisation of the grant
options.B: Permissible without any restriction
options.C: A matter to be regularised by the Tender Committee
options.D: A breach of financial propriety

q: The unspent balance of a grant or allotment remaining at the close of the financial year:

options.A: Is automatically carried forward to the next year
options.B: Lapses, and is not available for expenditure in the next year without a fresh allotment
options.C: Is transferred to the Development Fund
options.D: Can be spent in April of the next year without any sanction

q: An officer who sanctions or incurs expenditure in excess of the funds allotted to him, or without proper authority, is:

options.A: Not responsible so long as the work executed is useful
options.B: Protected by post-facto sanction in every case
options.C: Held personally responsible for the irregular expenditure
options.D: Required only to explain the matter to the Tender Committee

q:
Consider the following statements:
1. A loss of railway money or stores is written off only after a proper enquiry and with the sanction of the competent authority.
2. Once a loss has been written off, an official whose negligence caused the loss stands absolved of the liability to make good the loss.
Which of the statements is/are correct?

options.A: 1 only
options.B: 2 only
options.C: Both 1 and 2
options.D: Neither 1 nor 2

q: If the successful tenderer fails to furnish the Performance Guarantee/Security Deposit within the period stipulated after the issue of the Letter of Acceptance, the Railways may:

options.A: Extend the period indefinitely without any condition
options.B: Waive the requirement of the guarantee altogether
options.C: Furnish the guarantee amount on behalf of the contractor
options.D: Cancel the acceptance of the tender and forfeit the Earnest Money Deposit
